expert_term.en: court expert appointed by the pre-trial officer, prosecutor or court; experts on the List of Court Experts of the Republic of Lithuania take an oath on entry

appointment.basis: Baudžiamojo proceso kodeksas (BPK) 84-88, 210, 211, 286 straipsniai (appointment article for the pre-trial stage not verified)
appointment.summary_en: BPK arts. 84-88 set out the concept of expert, rights, duties, liability and the content of the expert report. Art. 210 covers assigning an examination to a person not on the list of experts; art. 211 covers acquainting participants with the expert report; art. 286 covers ordering an examination during the trial stage, including re-examination if the report is insufficiently complete or reasoned.

questions.summary_en: The questions are set in the ruling ordering the examination and listed in the report's introductory part. The expert's conclusions may not exceed the expert's special knowledge (art. 88). Where the material is insufficient or the questions fall outside the expert's competence, the expert draws up an act stating that a conclusion cannot be given (art. 286). Whether the expert may report facts not asked about was not verified.

items_en: introductory part: date and place of the report; the ruling ordering the examination; material and questions submitted; expert's name, education, speciality, qualification and length of service as expert; start and end dates of the examination; persons present during the examination
research part: condition of the objects examined; results of their inspection; examinations carried out, methods and tools used; results obtained and their evaluation
conclusions (must not exceed the expert's special knowledge)

rights_duties.summary_en: Rights, duties and liability of the expert are set in BPK arts. 84-87; details not verified on the official portal.

appointment.basis: Civilinio proceso kodeksas (CPK) 192-217 straipsniai (rules on witnesses and experts); exact article numbers not verified
appointment.summary_en: An expert opinion is given only on the court's assignment and set out in writing as an expert report (ekspertizės aktas). If the court requests an opinion without an expert report, it is treated as written evidence.

questions.summary_en: The report must give reasoned answers to the questions put by the court. At the hearing, questions to explain or supplement the opinion are first put by the person who requested the examination, then by other participants (by the plaintiff first if the court ordered it on its own motion); judges may ask at any time.

items_en: detailed description of the examinations carried out
reasoned answers to the questions put by the court
where the examination is done outside a hearing: the oath text signed by the expert, which forms an integral part of the report (not required from experts on the List of Court Experts)
items_local: pagrįsti atsakymai į teismo iškeltus klausimus
eksperto pasirašytas priesaikos tekstas yra ekspertizės akto sudedamoji dalis

rights_duties.basis: CPK (article not verified); CPK 248 straipsnis (fine for non-appearance)
rights_duties.summary_en: Experts on the List of Court Experts who took the oath on entry need not take it in court and are deemed warned of liability for a false opinion and explanations. An expert who fails to appear without good reason may be fined (amount on the e-Justice page is stated in litas and is outdated).

statute.title_en: Law on Forensic Examination of the Republic of Lithuania

liability.norm: Baudžiamasis kodeksas (BK) 235 straipsnis (as given in the task brief; not verified)

declaration.basis: CPK (article not verified): civil-procedure expert oath; when the examination is carried out outside a hearing the signed oath text is an integral part of the expert report
declaration.text_local: Aš, (vardas, pavardė), garbingai prisiekiu, kad sąžiningai vykdysiu savo pareigą remiantis visomis turimomis žiniomis pateikti objektyvią ir pagrįstą išvadą byloje
declaration.text_en: I, (name, surname), solemnly swear that I will honestly perform my duty to give, on the basis of all my knowledge, an objective and reasoned opinion in the case.

esignature.law_local: Europos Parlamento ir Tarybos reglamentas (ES) Nr. 910/2014 (eIDAS), iš dalies pakeistas reglamentu (ES) 2024/1183
esignature.law_en: Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 (eIDAS) as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1183; national implementing act not verified

timestamp.basis: Regulation (EU) No 910/2014, art. 41 (Lithuanian version: 'kvalifikuota elektroninė laiko žyma'), as amended by Regulation (EU) 2024/1183
timestamp.qualified_recognition: A qualified electronic time stamp enjoys the presumption of accuracy of the date and time it indicates and of the integrity of the data bound to them.
